accepted.quote: H.R. 4690, the ``Reliable Federal Infrastructure Act,'' would enable government waste and increase costs for taxpayers by repealing the phase out of fossil fuel-generated energy consumption in new and substantially renovated Federal buildings.
accepted.bill: H.R. 4690, the Reliable Federal Infrastructure Act
accepted.rationale: Pallone opposes repealing the fossil-fuel phase-out for federal buildings, indicating support for federal building energy efficiency standards.

accepted.quote: The standards also slash planet-warming emissions and provide health benefits to Federal workers and neighboring communities through reduced air pollution.
accepted.bill: H.R. 4690, the Reliable Federal Infrastructure Act
accepted.rationale: Pallone cites emissions reductions and reduced air pollution as benefits of the standards he supports.

accepted.quote: Repealing the standards will increase costs and air pollution, as well as harm innovation and grid reliability.
accepted.bill: H.R. 4690, the Reliable Federal Infrastructure Act
accepted.rationale: Pallone argues that repealing the standards would harm grid reliability, indicating support for reliability-enhancing efficiency measures.
